name: Grade Upon Technology Corp
summary: Grade Upon Technology Corp engages in the research, design, development, manufacturing, sales, and leasing of intelligent automation systems and electronic components for high-tech industries in Taiwan, Singapore, Mainland China, and internationally. It provides customized integrated solutions, leveraging IoT sensors, AI-powered machine vision, machine hearing, and machine olfaction to enable equipment networking, data acquisition, and AI-based anomaly detection systems. The company also develops remote operations systems and intelligent collaborative control systems.
